-- c00malw exploit COOL (LALOL Hub UI style with Mini Delta Executor, Scripts, and Classic tabs, Full Orange Theme)
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local PlayerGui = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

-- Notification on load (LALOL style, no icon)
local notifyEvent = Instance.new("BindableFunction")
notifyEvent.OnInvoke = function()
    setclipboard('https://discord.gg/MErYuJHdx')
end
game.StarterGui:SetCore("SendNotification", {
    Title = "c00malw exploit COOL",
    Text = "Thanks for using! Join Discord for updates.",
    Icon = "",
    Duration = 5,
    Button1 = "Join Discord",
    Callback = notifyEvent
})

-- Main ScreenGui
local ScreenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
ScreenGui.Name = "c00malwExploitCOOL"
ScreenGui.Parent = PlayerGui
ScreenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
ScreenGui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling

-- Main Window Frame
local MainFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
MainFrame.Name = "MainFrame"
MainFrame.Parent = ScreenGui
MainFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 80, 0) -- Dark orange
MainFrame.BorderSizePixel = 0
MainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -200, 0.5, -150)
MainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 400, 0, 300)
MainFrame.Active = true
MainFrame.Draggable = true
MainFrame.ClipsDescendants = true

local MainCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
MainCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
MainCorner.Parent = MainFrame

-- Top Bar
local TopBar = Instance.new("Frame")
TopBar.Name = "TopBar"
TopBar.Parent = MainFrame
TopBar.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 100, 0) -- Medium orange
TopBar.BorderSizePixel = 0
TopBar.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30)

local TopCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
TopCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
TopCorner.Parent = TopBar

-- Title Text
local TitleLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
TitleLabel.Name = "TitleLabel"
TitleLabel.Parent = TopBar
TitleLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
TitleLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 0)
TitleLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -60, 1, 0)
TitleLabel.Text = "c00malw exploit COOL"
TitleLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
TitleLabel.TextSize = 14
TitleLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
TitleLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left

-- Close Button
local CloseButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
CloseButton.Name = "CloseButton"
CloseButton.Parent = TopBar
CloseButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 128, 0) -- Orange
CloseButton.BorderSizePixel = 0
CloseButton.Position = UDim2.new(1, -25, 0, 2.5)
CloseButton.Size = UDim2.new(0, 20, 0, 25)
CloseButton.Text = "×"
CloseButton.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
CloseButton.TextSize = 16
CloseButton.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold

local CloseCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
CloseCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)
CloseCorner.Parent = CloseButton

CloseButton.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
    TweenService:Create(CloseButton, TweenInfo.new(0.2), {BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 160, 0)}):Play() -- Lighter orange
end)
CloseButton.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
    TweenService:Create(CloseButton, TweenInfo.new(0.2), {BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 128, 0)}):Play()
end)
CloseButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    ScreenGui:Destroy()
end)

-- Side Tab Panel
local SidePanel = Instance.new("Frame")
SidePanel.Name = "SidePanel"
SidePanel.Parent = MainFrame
SidePanel.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(210, 90, 0) -- Orange
SidePanel.BorderSizePixel = 0
SidePanel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 30)
SidePanel.Size = UDim2.new(0, 100, 1, -30)

local SideCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
SideCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 0)
SideCorner.Parent = SidePanel

-- Tab System
local Tabs = {}
local CurrentTab = nil

local function createTabButton(name, position)
    local TabButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
    TabButton.Name = name .. "Tab"
    TabButton.Parent = SidePanel
    TabButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 128, 0) -- Orange
    TabButton.BorderSizePixel = 0
    TabButton.Position = position
    TabButton.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 40)
    TabButton.Text = name
    TabButton.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    TabButton.TextSize = 12
    TabButton.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham

    local TabCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    TabCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)
    TabCorner.Parent = TabButton

    TabButton.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
        TweenService:Create(TabButton, TweenInfo.new(0.2), {BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 160, 0)}):Play() -- Lighter orange
    end)
    TabButton.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
        if CurrentTab ~= name then
            TweenService:Create(TabButton, TweenInfo.new(0.2), {BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 128, 0)}):Play()
        end
    end)

    return TabButton
end

local function createTabContent(name)
    local ContentFrame = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
    ContentFrame.Name = name .. "Content"
    ContentFrame.Parent = MainFrame
    ContentFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    ContentFrame.BorderSizePixel = 0
    ContentFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0, 100, 0, 30)
    ContentFrame.Size = UDim2.new(1, -100, 1, -30)
    ContentFrame.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 300)
    ContentFrame.ScrollBarThickness = 6
    ContentFrame.ScrollBarImageColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 128, 0) -- Orange scrollbar
    ContentFrame.Visible = false
    return ContentFrame
end

local function switchTab(tabName)
    if CurrentTab == tabName then return end
    if CurrentTab then
        Tabs[CurrentTab].Content.Visible = false
        TweenService:Create(Tabs[CurrentTab].Button, TweenInfo.new(0.2), {BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 128, 0)}):Play()
    end
    CurrentTab = tabName
    Tabs[tabName].Content.Visible = true
    TweenService:Create(Tabs[tabName].Button, TweenInfo.new(0.2), {BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 160, 0)}):Play()
end

-- Main Tab
Tabs.Main = {}
Tabs.Main.Button = createTabButton("Main", UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0))
Tabs.Main.Content = createTabContent("Main")
Tabs.Main.Button.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() switchTab("Main") end)

-- Scripts Tab
Tabs.Scripts = {}
Tabs.Scripts.Button = createTabButton("Scripts", UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 40))
Tabs.Scripts.Content = createTabContent("Scripts")
Tabs.Scripts.Button.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() switchTab("Scripts") end)

-- Classic Tab
Tabs.Classic = {}
Tabs.Classic.Button = createTabButton("Classic", UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 80))
Tabs.Classic.Content = createTabContent("Classic")
Tabs.Classic.Button.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() switchTab("Classic") end)

-- Main Tab: Executor (Mini Delta style)
local CodeBox = Instance.new("TextBox")
CodeBox.Name = "CodeBox"
CodeBox.Parent = Tabs.Main.Content
CodeBox.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 70, 0) -- Dark orange
CodeBox.BorderSizePixel = 0
CodeBox.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 10)
CodeBox.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 200)
CodeBox.Text = "-- Enter your Lua code here"
CodeBox.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255) -- White text
CodeBox.TextSize = 14
CodeBox.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSans
CodeBox.MultiLine = true
CodeBox.ClearTextOnFocus = false
CodeBox.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
CodeBox.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top

local CodeBoxCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
CodeBoxCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
CodeBoxCorner.Parent = CodeBox

-- Buttons Frame (Execute, Clear, Copy)
local ButtonsFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
ButtonsFrame.Name = "ButtonsFrame"
ButtonsFrame.Parent = Tabs.Main.Content
ButtonsFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
ButtonsFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 220)
ButtonsFrame.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 40)

local ExecuteButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
ExecuteButton.Name = "ExecuteButton"
ExecuteButton.Parent = ButtonsFrame
ExecuteButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 128, 0) -- Orange
ExecuteButton.BorderSizePixel = 0
ExecuteButton.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
ExecuteButton.Size = UDim2.new(0.33, -5, 1, 0)
ExecuteButton.Text = "Execute"
ExecuteButton.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
ExecuteButton.TextSize = 14
ExecuteButton.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham

local ExecuteCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
ExecuteCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)
ExecuteCorner.Parent = ExecuteButton

local ClearButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
ClearButton.Name = "ClearButton"
ClearButton.Parent = ButtonsFrame
ClearButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 128, 0) -- Orange
ClearButton.BorderSizePixel = 0
ClearButton.Position = UDim2.new(0.33, 5, 0, 0)
ClearButton.Size = UDim2.new(0.33, -5, 1, 0)
ClearButton.Text = "Clear"
ClearButton.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
ExecuteButton.TextSize = 14
ExecuteButton.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham

local ClearCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
ClearCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)
ClearCorner.Parent = ClearButton

local CopyButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
CopyButton.Name = "CopyButton"
CopyButton.Parent = ButtonsFrame
CopyButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 128, 0) -- Orange
CopyButton.BorderSizePixel = 0
CopyButton.Position = UDim2.new(0.66, 5, 0, 0)
CopyButton.Size = UDim2.new(0.33, -5, 1, 0)
CopyButton.Text = "Copy"
CopyButton.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
CopyButton.TextSize = 14
CopyButton.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham

local CopyCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
CopyCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)
CopyCorner.Parent = CopyButton

local function addHover(button, normalColor, hoverColor)
    button.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
        TweenService:Create(button, TweenInfo.new(0.2), {BackgroundColor3 = hoverColor}):Play()
    end)
    button.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
        TweenService:Create(button, TweenInfo.new(0.2), {BackgroundColor3 = normalColor}):Play()
    end)
end
addHover(ExecuteButton, Color3.fromRGB(255, 128, 0), Color3.fromRGB(255, 160, 0))
addHover(ClearButton, Color3.fromRGB(255, 128, 0), Color3.fromRGB(255, 160, 0))
addHover(CopyButton, Color3.fromRGB(255, 128, 0), Color3.fromRGB(255, 160, 0))

-- Executor Logic
ExecuteButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    local code = CodeBox.Text
    if code and code ~= "" then
        local success, result = pcall(function()
            return loadstring(code)()
        end)
        if not success then
            warn("Error executing code: " .. tostring(result))
        end
    else
        warn("No code to execute!")
    end
end)

ClearButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    CodeBox.Text = ""
end)

CopyButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    setclipboard(CodeBox.Text)
    game.StarterGui:SetCore("SendNotification", {
        Title = "c00malw exploit COOL",
        Text = "Code copied to clipboard!",
        Icon = "",
        Duration = 3
    })
end)

-- Scripts Tab: Infinite Yield Only
local scripts = {
    {Name = "Infinite Yield", URL = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/EdgeIY/infiniteyield/master/source"}
}

local scriptListY = 10
for i, script in ipairs(scripts) do
    local ScriptButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
    ScriptButton.Name = script.Name .. "Button"
    ScriptButton.Parent = Tabs.Scripts.Content
    ScriptButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 128, 0) -- Orange
    ScriptButton.BorderSizePixel = 0
    ScriptButton.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, scriptListY)
    ScriptButton.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 30)
    ScriptButton.Text = script.Name
    ScriptButton.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    ScriptButton.TextSize = 12
    ScriptButton.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham

    local ScriptCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    ScriptCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)
    ScriptCorner.Parent = ScriptButton

    addHover(ScriptButton, Color3.fromRGB(255, 128, 0), Color3.fromRGB(255, 160, 0))

    ScriptButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        local success, code = pcall(function()
            return game:HttpGet(script.URL)
        end)
        if success then
            CodeBox.Text = "loadstring(game:HttpGet('" .. script.URL .. "'))()"
            switchTab("Main")
            game.StarterGui:SetCore("SendNotification", {
                Title = "c00malw exploit COOL",
                Text = script.Name .. " loaded to executor!",
                Icon = "",
                Duration = 3
            })
        else
            warn("Failed to load script: " .. script.Name)
        end
    end)

    scriptListY = scriptListY + 40
end
Tabs.Scripts.Content.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, scriptListY)

-- Classic Tab: Custom Scripts (Inf Jump, Speed 100, Noclip)
local classicScripts = {
    {Name = "Infinite Jump", Code = [[
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

UserInputService.JumpRequest:Connect(function()
    if LocalPlayer.Character then
        LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid"):ChangeState("Jumping")
    end
end)
print("Infinite Jump enabled!")
]]},
    {Name = "Speed (100)", Code = [[
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

if LocalPlayer.Character then
    LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid").WalkSpeed = 100
    print("Speed set to 100!")
end
]]},
    {Name = "Noclip", Code = [[
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local noclip = false

local function toggleNoclip()
    noclip = not noclip
    if noclip and LocalPlayer.Character then
        for _, part in pairs(LocalPlayer.Character:GetDescendants()) do
            if part:IsA("BasePart") then
                part.CanCollide = false
            end
        end
        print("Noclip enabled!")
    elseif LocalPlayer.Character then
        for _, part in pairs(LocalPlayer.Character:GetDescendants()) do
            if part:IsA("BasePart") then
                part.CanCollide = true
            end
        end
        print("Noclip disabled!")
    end
end

game:GetService("UserInputService").InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.E then
        toggleNoclip()
    end
end)
print("Noclip bound to E key!")
]]}
}

local classicListY = 10
for i, script in ipairs(classicScripts) do
    local ScriptButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
    ScriptButton.Name = script.Name .. "Button"
    ScriptButton.Parent = Tabs.Classic.Content
    ScriptButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 128, 0) -- Orange
    ScriptButton.BorderSizePixel = 0
    ScriptButton.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, classicListY)
    ScriptButton.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 30)
    ScriptButton.Text = script.Name
    ScriptButton.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    ScriptButton.TextSize = 12
    ScriptButton.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham

    local ScriptCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    ScriptCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)
    ScriptCorner.Parent = ScriptButton

    addHover(ScriptButton, Color3.fromRGB(255, 128, 0), Color3.fromRGB(255, 160, 0))

    ScriptButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        CodeBox.Text = script.Code
        switchTab("Main")
        game.StarterGui:SetCore("SendNotification", {
            Title = "c00malw exploit COOL",
            Text = script.Name .. " loaded to executor!",
            Icon = "",
            Duration = 3
        })
    end)

    classicListY = classicListY + 40
end
Tabs.Classic.Content.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, classicListY)

-- Initialize with Main tab open
switchTab("Main")

print("c00malw exploit COOL menu loaded! (LALOL Hub style with Mini Delta Executor, Scripts, and Classic tabs, Full Orange Theme)")
